scope: Prospective operator reference specification for the unchanged Figure 6h-i task; not an executable driver, runtime or authenticated historical caller.

information_policy.role: Operator/reference documentation, containing author-code-derived implementation details; do not include it in paper+data participant material.
information_policy.paired_conditions: Both participant conditions must use the same admitted scientific observations, realized support, evaluation and resource contract. Official-code access is their intended information difference.
information_policy.missing_enforcement: This public documentation creates no protected delivery, access isolation, runtime or information-budget enforcement.
information_policy.historical_scores: Published workbook and private fresh-reference outputs remain evaluator-side; no source score values are copied into this recipe.

locators: Selection of the latent state dimension
Additional generalizations of state dynamics, Eqs. 12–13

official_code.role: Publication-era source candidate explicitly selected for this unexecuted specification; not proven historical execution revision.

cohort.selector: Chronologically first seven Indy sessions in the cited release list of broadband-available sessions, matching paper endpoints 20160622/01–20160921/01.
cohort.catalog_limit: Expected URLs, sizes and MD5 values describe release assets. No acquired arrays or historical execution are authenticated.
cohort.electrodes: Paper specifies a random subset of 32 of 96 M1 electrodes. Eligible identity, sharing across sessions and unit-inclusion semantics still require binding for a fresh realization. Do not tune random draws to the reported 77–99-unit range.

scientific_endpoint.prediction: One step ahead from past neural observations; held behavior is a target, never an inference input.
scientific_endpoint.neural: Spiking activity: nonoverlapping 10-ms counts, Gaussian smoothing with 50-ms standard deviation, sampled at 50-ms steps.
scientific_endpoint.behavior_clock: Matching 50-ms steps; exact cursor velocity derivation and alignment remain unresolved.
scientific_endpoint.reporting: Seven sessions × five temporal outer folds × seven methods; both endpoint coordinates and all eight latent dimensions retained. The 35 folds are dependent evaluations from one animal.

folds_and_scaling.paper: Five continuous outer test segments per session; two inner folds only within the outer training observations.
folds_and_scaling.source_supported_fresh_remainder: genCVFoldInds(N, 5, shuffle=False) for outer support, and declared two-fold genCVFoldInds on outer-training support; ceil-sized successive test segments with last shortened. This is released-source-supported, not authenticated historical remainder handling.
folds_and_scaling.source_default_gap_behavior: Generic CV concatenates remaining temporal training rows. It does not insert a new state reset at an interior held-out gap.
folds_and_scaling.wrapper_scaling: Generic CV defaults train-only per-channel zScoreY/zScoreZ and mean removal true; publication parser's model-internal zscore false prevents assuming these are the same layer. Original caller switch values are not established by defaults alone. Bind the complete wrapper explicitly.
folds_and_scaling.existing_component_limit: inner-preparation-v1 prepares already authenticated outer-training arrays only; it is not a raw-data constructor.
folds_and_scaling.binding_required: Record original row/time/channel IDs, exact per-fold membership, all four scaling flags, and test initial-state/warm-up policy before execution. No new fold profile is selected here.

model_recipe.individual_nonlinearity: One 64-unit ReLU hidden layer at the selected mapping; other mappings linear.
model_recipe.flexible_search: 61 ordinary-recursion cases plus 29 LSTM-recursion cases, with one/two hidden layers and 64/128 units; twofold inner selection. The uAK code uses joint state/input recursion when both A and K are nonlinear, as prescribed by Eqs. 12–13.
model_recipe.selection: Behavior-focused and neural-focused flexible profiles retain both directions. The source helper implements primary-mean eligibility using the maximum lower one-SEM bound over candidates, then the best secondary mean. Record tie behavior.
model_recipe.dimension_selection: For each method and outer fold, choose the larger of the smallest dimensions reaching peak neural and peak behavior performance in training data. Do not select from outer-test score arrays; retain the full eight-dimension panel.
model_recipe.optimization: Adam; up to 2500 epochs; training-loss patience 3. Explicitly bind initialization attempts, failure retries, seed derivation and their cumulative costs.

step4_exclusion.condition: 0 < n1 < nx, hence nx in [32,64,128] here
step4_exclusion.interaction: model2_Cz_Full=True would re-enable Cz2. Both flags must be false; no FCz or skipCy change.

model_recipe.source_execution_semantics: Continuous arrays use stateful training. Released defaults use 128-sample blocks, initial batch size 32 adjusted to length, no shuffle, and omit incomplete training batch tails. Prediction resets on each call, pads to full blocks, then trims to requested length. Record actual exposures and score all admitted test rows.

source_call_plan.primary_entry_signature: doCVedModelFit(Y, Z, methodCodes, CVFolds, nxVals, U=None, n1Vals=None, trueSys=None, saveFile=None, CVFoldInds=None, T=None, YType=None, ZType=None, UType=None, ZClasses=None, settings={}, comparisonRef=None)
source_call_plan.primary_entry_use_limit: Use within protected outer-training selection or with already frozen hyperparameters. Do not select dimension from its outer-test perfAll outputs.
source_call_plan.per_dimension_architecture_entry_signatu: fitDPADWithFlexibleNonlinearity(Y, Z=None, U=None, nx=None, n1=None, methodCode='DPAD_GSUT_iCVF2_LSTM_uAKCzCy3HL128U', settings=None, saveDir='./results', saveFName=None, addDataHashToSavePath=True, addMethodCodeToSavePath=True)
source_call_plan.per_dimension_architecture_call: selectedMethodCode, iCVRes = fitDPADWithFlexibleNonlinearity(Y_outer_train, Z=Z_outer_train, nx=nx, n1=min(16,nx), methodCode=declared_90_case_code, settings=explicit_settings, saveDir=owned_output)
source_call_plan.per_dimension_architecture_warning: Override the function default3HL with the paper2HL code; pass only outer-training data. Selection code is returned, not a fitted final model.

model.fit(Y_outer_train_scaled.T, Z_outer_train_scaled.T, nx=selected_nx, n1=min(16,selected_nx), YType='cont', ZType='cont', **args)
evaluation_calls: evaluateDecoding(ZTest=Z_outer_test_scaled, zPredTest=z_pred, YTest=Y_outer_test_scaled, yPredTest=y_pred, missing_marker=declared_marker, YType='cont', ZType='cont', measures=['CC'])

refit_sequence: Admit the completed observation recipe, exact array identities and outer folds before any fitting.
Within each outer training partition, evaluate all eight dimensions and full method/architecture alternatives, with twofold inner architecture selection and train-only scaling.

Freeze a training-selected architecture for every method and dimension, and each method's reported dimension using the larger of the two smallest training-only peak dimensions; never select from outer-test perfAll.

Refit all seven methods at all eight dimensions on the complete outer training support using explicit publication settings and declared stochastic attempts. Retain all 56 method/dimension prediction cases per outer fold, 1,960 across seven sessions and five folds; only the frozen training-selected dimension drives each method's reported two-coordinate comparison.
Freeze code, preprocessing, selected models and resource records before protected test evaluation; infer from past neural test observations only.
Retain named per-channel and session-fold predictions/scores, validity masks, selection records, failures and full joint-frontier contrasts.

evaluation.source_frontier: Explicit min_relative_diff=0.01 plus paired one-sided signed-rank P<=0.05. Retain both neural and behavior coordinates and the source joint-frontier logic.
evaluation.validity: Optional sanitize_perfs can turn flat channels into NaN and use nanmean; old flag differs. Final caller choice not established. Must retain masks and qualify a declared policy, not require historical predictions categorically.
evaluation.candidate_failure: Must independently reject/penalize invalid candidate outputs rather than let prediction-dependent row removal improve a score
evaluation.inference_limit: The paper frontier is not a reproduction-equivalence band or a new improvement margin. Dependence-aware uncertainty and meaningful-improvement admission remain separately unresolved.

implementation_profile_limits: initial-evaluator-v1 requires N divisible by 5 because held_ids constructs equal floor-sized blocks; relaxing the guard alone would lose tail rows.
paired-candidate-v2 pins the predecessor source SHA and inherits its fold profile; paired and inner-preparation components admit 77–99 neural channels.
These are restrictions of retained calibration/component profiles, not proof of universal paper sampling rules or observed authentic prepared-array extents.
A fresh variable-width/ceil-fold profile requires an explicitly reviewed schema, identity binding and complete-tail handling after preparation qualification. None is activated here.

Existing evaluator reference_kind accepts only generated_engineering_control or owner_supplied_unverified. No scientifically admitted fresh panel is currently shown to be rejected. A future qualified input outside these guards needs a versioned channel/full-tail interface with focused controls; documentation alone would not repair that executable mismatch.
still_unresolved: Raw-array content and actual channel/unit identities; electrode population/sharing/inclusion rule for a fresh draw.
Timestamp support, 10-ms bin origin/edges, clipping, Gaussian kernel support/boundary/fold context and 50-ms decimation phase.
Cursor velocity construction, position/velocity resampling and common-clock alignment.
Wrapper scaling, initialization/retry count, warm-up/validity/sanitization choices and actual trained-model/prediction evidence.
Compatible runtime and parser/model qualification, protected paired delivery and cumulative resource/access budgets.

original_schema_timing_can_resolve: M1 channel identities and unit slots
actual finite/constant-channel incidence under a bounded check
raw_arrays_cannot_identify_without_prove: historical fold remainder and initialization settings
next_discriminating_inspection.remaining_artifact: A compact observation-construction function/config, or independently justified and scientifically qualified reconstruction, is sufficient. Historical weights, RNG state and exact old software bytes are not categorical prerequisites.
